title: yoke-global reaches outside-project sessions only once machine-wide hooks ship
text: yoke-global now picks or adds the project, carries the user's request and names the folder where a new session runs /yoke onboard, and outside-project orientation names it as the next action. Setup installs it in ~/.agents/skills/yoke-global with a Claude link. The orientation reaches a session only through the machine-wide hooks; until they ship and a released candidate proves receipt on every harness, a session outside a project still starts without it.
